_note: Deterministic redlines used in mock mode. dollars_at_risk is NOT stored here; src/agents/contract_exposer.py computes it from src/finance.

merchant_agreement.revised: Merchant may terminate at any time on 30 days' written notice. No liquidated damages apply.
merchant_agreement.why: Half your average processor fees for every month left on the contract. This is the clause that traps owners into overpaying.

merchant_agreement.revised: After the initial term this Agreement continues month-to-month and either party may cancel on 30 days' notice.
merchant_agreement.why: Miss a 30-day window and you are locked in for three more years.

merchant_agreement.revised: Merchant may return leased equipment and end the lease on 30 days' notice, or buy it out for $99.
merchant_agreement.why: 48 months at $69.95 is $3,357.60 for a terminal that sells for about $300, and you can't cancel the lease.

merchant_agreement.revised: Fee increases require Merchant's written consent. Merchant may terminate without penalty within 60 days of any increase.
merchant_agreement.why: They can raise your fees with a line of small print on a statement.

merchant_agreement.revised: Processor will help Merchant complete the PCI self-assessment (SAQ) within 30 days; no non-compliance fee will be charged.
merchant_agreement.why: You pay this every month until you fill out a free questionnaire.
Competitors in this market offer month-to-month terms with no exit fee.

mca_offer.revised: Disclose the estimated APR (about 93%) and the total cost of financing ($15,200) before signing, as state disclosure rules require.
mca_offer.why: '1.35 factor' sounds like 35%. Because the money is paid back daily over about 9 months, the real annual cost is close to triple that.

mca_offer.revised: Strike entirely. Disputes resolved by notice and a hearing.
mca_offer.why: Lets the funder get a court judgment against you without telling you first. Banned for out-of-state use in New York.

mca_offer.revised: Security interest limited to the specific receivables purchased. No restriction on other financing.
mca_offer.why: Ties up every asset you own and blocks you from getting a cheaper SBA or bank loan to refinance.

mca_offer.revised: Daily remittance is 6% of actual card sales, reconciled weekly at Merchant's request.
mca_offer.why: A fixed debit means on a slow Tuesday they still take $197.26. A true sales-based advance moves with your sales.

mca_offer.revised: No origination fee, or fee included in the disclosed finance charge.
mca_offer.why: You receive $38,800, not $40,000, but pay back as if you got the full amount.

mca_offer.revised: Early payoff receives a pro-rated discount of the unearned finance charge.
mca_offer.why: Paying early saves you nothing, so there is no way out of the cost.
